token_types.output: output tokens; reasoning tokens are billed at this price
token_types.cache_read: input tokens read from a prompt cache; priced as input where the source lists no cache-read price
token_types.cache_write: input tokens written to a prompt cache; priced as input where the source lists no cache-write price

tier_price_structure.eci>=N: all token types from the cheapest model (by blended price) at or above the threshold
tier_price_structure.small, mid, frontier: all token types from the median model by blended price among the tier's models (two middle models averaged for an even count; models tied at the median averaged); base = that month among the last 3 whose median blended price is their median

tiers_added_in_v4.small: median price of models 15-30 ECI points below the best priced model that month, released in the last 12 months; v3's base-case rule

meta.months: months_ahead 0 = the base level in the anchor month; 1-36 = forward curve

scenarios.fast: v3 fast (constant-capability decline unless the base is steeper)

meta.rate_by_type: every token type moves at its tier's v3 annual factor (v3 fits rates on blended prices)
meta.capability_lookup: capability_v4.csv: cheapest model with ECI >= eci_min; scenario 'history' for past months; forward rate from the v3 band priced by the same model, else the nearest v3 band below
